Recorded claim:
Bug 1894048 found a large set of collected contacts with PreferDisplayName off. An earlier behavior change made that stored per-contact state visible as an unexpected name change. The accepted fix removed the checkbox and writes from the address-book editor and collector, removed the per-card check from JS and C++ formatters, and kept the global mail.showCondensedAddresses control. Current JS formatter still reads card.displayName directly. When changing name display, distinguish the global display policy from contact data; check collected and existing contacts as well as new ones. Do not reintroduce PreferDisplayName as if it were part of vCard.
